description: Source code for computing per-sample gradients in PyTorch, demonstrating both manual and functorch-based approaches, including a simple CNN model, gradient computations, and usage of functorch's functional transformations.

classes.name: SimpleCNN
classes.description: A simple convolutional neural network model for image classification.

methods.name: loss_fn
methods.description: Computes the negative log likelihood loss between predictions and targets.

methods.name: compute_grad
methods.description: Computes per-sample gradients for a given data sample and target.

methods.name: compute_sample_grads
methods.description: Computes per-sample gradients for the entire batch of data and targets.

methods.name: compute_loss
methods.description: Computes the loss for a single sample and target using the functional model.
